title: U6 receipt common definitions
description: Shared identity, clock and code definitions.

runID.description: Run identity from the lease; binds every receipt to this run.

epoch.description: Lease epoch; binds every receipt to this attempt.

pid.description: Process identifier of the registered subject.

seq.description: Per-process sequence, strictly increasing in file order; orders app rows.

mono.description: Seconds of ProcessInfo.systemUptime (fractional); orders rows across processes.

at.description: UNIX seconds (fractional); informational only, never used for ordering.

objectID.description: Decimal ObjectIdentifier bit pattern of a live AppKit object; stable while it lives.

generation.description: Consent generation; only meaningful paired with its storeEpoch.

scenarioReason.description: C2.4 section 5 scenario reasons; free text never appears.
